name: @gears-frontx/design-verify
description: Design-verification workspace package delivered by @gears-frontx/template-design-guardrails: the dev-only runtime design-defect checker (axe-core + objective layout rules), the composed-markup axe test suite, and the jsx-a11y lint fragment. The shell wires each of these in optionally, so an app without the guardrails template carries no verification machinery.
